meta.name: creator-content-auditor
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "review this influencer content" or "check if this post meets brand guidelines"; runs the typed STAR pre-publish gate, scores Trust and Appeal on the deliverable, folds in the creator Suitability read, computes the profile-weighted SQS, checks the disclosure/claim/brand-safety and fraud/fake-engagement vetoes, and writes constructive revision feedback. Not for drafting the brief — use brief-generator; not for partnership terms — use contract-helper.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审核创作者内容是否符合品牌标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保创作者内容符合品牌指南和合规要求。
copy.tagline_en: Review creator content against brand guidelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure creator content meets brand guidelines and compliance.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照 STAR 框架审核创作者提交的内容，评估信任度、吸引力、适配性和回报，计算 SQS 分数，检查披露、声明、品牌安全和虚假互动等否决项，并给出修改反馈。
howto.when: 当用户要求审核创作者内容或检查帖子是否符合品牌指南时触发。也适用于修订版内容需要重新审核的场景。

say.text: 审核这个赞助视频和文案是否符合简报 v4 的转化目标。
say.note: Claude 会运行 STAR 门控并输出 SQS 分数。

say.text: 检查这篇帖子是否存在披露或声明问题。
say.note: Claude 会验证 FTC 披露和声明真实性。

say.text: 对这条内容给出创作者修改建议。
say.note: Claude 会提供具体位置和修改要求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude audits influencer content using the STAR framework: scores Trust, Appeal, Suitability, and Return; computes the profile-weighted SQS; checks disclosure, claim, brand-safety, and fraud vetoes; and writes constructive revision feedback.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to review influencer content or check if a post meets brand guidelines. Also applies to revised assets needing a traceable rerun against the same brief.

say_en.text: Review this sponsored video and caption against campaign brief v4 for conversion.
say_en.note: Claude runs the STAR gate and returns the SQS.

say_en.text: Check this post for disclosure or claim issues.
say_en.note: Claude verifies FTC disclosure and claim accuracy.

say_en.text: Give creator revision feedback for this content.
